integrity: The result isolates a finite-family gap in the flower construction of Proposition 12.3. Strict modal height/width do not count the cardinality of a reflexive cluster, and arbitrary repeated points may map homomorphically to one canonical bud representative. No assertion is made that the proposition itself is false.
scientific_limitations: The result does not disprove the blooming proposition or the finite model property of IK4. A finite reduced-petal or simulation-quotient repair may exist. It concerns the specified preprint version.
title: The all-petals flower need not be finite
